question: A common belief: 'ViT is mostly compute, needs more compute.' Measure, per GR00T stage and platform, what fraction of work is actual matmul/conv COMPUTE vs GLUE (softmax, norm, activation, elementwise, layout).
method: Per-op/per-layer profiling, fp16, batch 1. NVIDIA: trtexec --dumpProfile fresh fp16 builds (Thor TRT10.16.2, Orin TRT10.3) + 5090 via TRT IProfiler (roofline_prof.py). All from the SAME base fp16 ONNX ($GVRB_WORK/onnx/{eagle2/vit_fp16.onnx, eagle2/llm_fp16.onnx, action_head/DiT_fp16.onnx}).
HEADLINE: The 'compute %' a profiler reports for a GR00T stage reflects TensorRT fusion and per-architecture tactic choice, not a silicon compute ratio: TensorRT folds softmax/norm/activation glue into the matmul epilogue, so stages read ~84-92% 'compute' on Thor/Orin (Orin LLM after reconciliation), and the same ViT under the same TensorRT 10.16 reads 64% on the 5090 (Blackwell sm_120) and 90% on Thor (Blackwell sm_110).

nvidia_fused_view_trt.note: TRT myelin fusion folds softmax/norm/activation INTO the matmul epilogue -> reads as COMPUTE. Numbers are directional (fusion granularity + per-SM tactics + profiler differ). Thor is the cleanest internally-consistent set.

llm.orin: 66.1 MEASURED (classifier output) -> ~89 DERIVED by reconciliation (the fused attention block __myl_FcNegExpAddDivMulMul is mislabeled elementwise by name; reclassified as compute)

nvidia_fused_view_trt.classifier_caveats: Automated keyword classifier mislabels some fused Myelin blocks: node_linear_* (fixed: +linear/bmm/qkv -> COMPUTE); __myl_FcNegExp... (attention+softmax, reads elementwise); __mye<hex> super-blocks (unnamed adaLN, reads 'other'). Each was reconciled by elimination; Thor stages are clean because attention sits in named _gemm_mha_v2 blocks. The 5090's lower/uneven numbers (profiled via IProfiler on sm_120, less-aggressive fusion) show the metric depends on the compiler's per-architecture choices and on the profiling tool.

actionable: TRT fuses softmax+LN+GELU into the matmul kernels (reads 'compute' AND skips DDR round-trips). On a runtime that leaves each glue op as a separate kernel, the glue is exposed; operator fusion, not more matmul TOPS, is then the lever.
